cast_policy.missing_kind_or_level: reject encounter config, never infer from humanoid model
cast_policy.threshold_formula: current_hp*10000 <= maximum_hp*3000; target alive, positive valid maximum; checked before math
cast_policy.accept_and_impact: level/kind/HP threshold/alive/hostility/range/LOS checked before cost, and again at actual impact; healing above threshold before impact makes no-finishing-hit, no refund/cooldown reset
cast_policy.cooldown_group: one shared source_finishing_techniques group per caster600world steps, scopeexact12ability IDs inthisfile; choosing another tier cannot bypass. Original teaching_assassin_finisher keeps its own180step/3combo-point rules and isnotcaptured by the shared finishing_martial typeflag; ordinary root recovery lock still applies
cast_policy.damage: one root direct attack_martial_skill; use ability flat power not shared4L; own class profile coefficient15000, standard23hit/crit/mitigation, named power modifiers once
cast_policy.offensive_proc_policy: ordinary root eligible named procs still follow their own restrictions; finishing_martial flag blocks only passives explicitly excluding it; no implicit supercritical or universal passive immunity
cast_policy.chord_policy: these3musician finishers have no25normal-chord-advance tag; named梅花/鸾凤 trigger remains once by14 and own root receipts
cast_policy.death_result: only if this direct finisher event commits final death; reflected damage/DoT/derived extras/other killer never borrow its reward profile; compare actual death event ID not latest attacker
cast_policy.tier_choice: use exact paid ability reward profile; never highest learned level or automatic stronger fallback

reward_order.scope: ordinary monster kill reward components that explicitly opt into finishing modifiers; quest/activity-completion/first-clear/fixed proof/ascension-progress unchanged
reward_order.required_encounter_field: finishing_reward_components explicit subset of experience,practice,silver,random_drop; empty is an explicit no-bonus design only with reason; missing field rejects export
reward_order.xp_and_practice: floor(actual monster base component*exact finisher multiplier/10000) once, then19qualified-member5percent pool/level weights; explicit training recipient bonuses apply after allocation before personal caps, never repeat finisher per recipient or create a second death event
reward_order.silver: floor(explicit base silver*multiplier/10000) once in original shared drop bundle, same pickup rights as base loot; not a new personal copy for each party member
reward_order.random_drop: each opted-in ordinary random table chance=min(10000,floor(original_bp*profile.random_drop_chance_bp/10000)); relative chance not percentage-point addition or more independent rolls; quantity/item-pool weighting unchanged
reward_order.excluded_drops: fixed guaranteed, quest, exclusive activity, unique protected and once-per-world rewards never multiplied
reward_order.roll_position: profile fixed from final death receipt before sole drop draw; no ordinary draw then reroll as improved; preserve chosen outcomes and random cursor
reward_order.missing_base_drop_or_rewards: reject formal encounter definition, no base zero/free/generated table to conceal unfinished world design
reward_order.multiple_attackers: exact one killer/direct-root profile for one death; no stack across selected skills, assistants or two simultaneous projectiles
reward_order.atomicity: deathID/profile/base&modified pools/qualified recipients/drop outcomes/receipts submitted together on host; replays restore same result; client cannot claim bonus based on visual kill
reward_order.persistence: remaining shared cooldown and paid action/direct death receipt saved by05/23; pause/offline freeze, load/reconnect cannot redraw or re-credit

training_followup_owner.order: finisher base/ordinary chance first; eligible training personal reward after allocation or unique public silver/drop multiplier afterwards once
